payload.label: Show me once
payload.job: Record, for a short bounded time, what the person does on their Mac (clicks, typing, shortcuts, with the app and the control each was in) and give it back as a draft workflow in words an AI can keep after the person has looked at it
payload.description: Give seconds (1 to 300; 30 when left out). The recorder listens only: it posts, blocks and changes nothing, and the stop key (Escape) ends it early. Text typed in a secure field is never recorded; the draft says a secret was typed. Answers draft ({ id, label, job, steps: [{ id, title, do, submit }], dropped_steps }), events_seen, secrets_skipped, ended (time, stop_key, most_events) and said. Without the Mac's Input Monitoring for the recorder the run is refused in words. Bounds and every step's words: read-data/demonstration.json.

provenance.source: Moved from Trillion-X/trillion demonstration (computer/, deleted in dc79bb0a87)

laid_files.text: {"_what":"How read-data/demonstration.mjs (tool:record-a-demonstration) turns a short, bounded recording of what the person does on this Mac into a draft workflow for save_workflow. The recording is made by do-work/demonstration-recorder.swift (listen only; needs Input Monitoring, and Accessibility to name what was clicked). Typed text in a secure field is never recorded. The gates are the person's grant of the row's capability to this tool and the Mac's own Input Monitoring permission.
